intuition.title: Why grow a ferrite shell on CoO?
intuition.summary: Seed growth forms an inverted AFM-core/FiM-shell structure and allows the CoO core to remain highly crystalline. XRD alone does not prove geometry, as the paper explicitly acknowledges. No independent nucleation fraction is quantified.

intuition.title: Lattice shifts and the proposed interface strain
intuition.summary: Authors attribute the CoO shift to lattice mismatch and strain at the core–shell interface. The paper does not provide an atomically refined strain map or interface composition profile.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
